rules.name: typescript
rules.evidence: Preserve the native compiler's complete LICENSE, NOTICE.txt and nested vscode-jsonrpc MIT grant. Published gitHead 2bd066d87f5bafd315be9f40889d0a60b9e58e0b resolves in microsoft/typescript-go, whose go.mod matches NOTICE's x/sync 0.21.0, x/sys 0.46.0, x/term 0.44.0 and x/text 0.38.0. All four upstream tags carry identical Go LICENSE/PATENTS blobs; retain those original terms from the immutable x/sync 0.21.0 commit because NOTICE lists the grants without their full text. This does not certify redistribution of a complete prebuilt Go toolchain.

Keep each authenticated native archive's own Apache LICENSE and complete NOTICE.txt, supplemented by the same-version parent notices and original Go BSD/PATENTS terms. The exact native family shares the compiler source revision recorded by the parent rule; no metadata-only waiver or complete embedded-toolchain clearance is asserted.

rules.name: vswhom-sys
rules.evidence: The wrapper LICENSE grants MIT terms under nabijaczleweli's copyright. Its Windows build additionally compiles ext/vswhom.cpp, whose original header credits Jonathan Blow, dated 31 August 2018, and releases the helper under MIT. The auditor retains that header from the exact checksum-verified crate alongside the complete wrapper grant; published VCS commit 086e3af37e81051057257dfde855ed58a777fb0f independently confirms the source.

Authenticated same-version native manifests identify the Rolldown repository and MIT terms. Retain both parent LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY-LICENSE. These build executables are not app resources; available distribution notices do not establish complete embedded-native-component closure.

Platform binary packages identify the same Tauri repository/version and Apache-2.0 OR MIT. Both complete parent-package notices retained; selected MIT. CLI build executables are not shipped as GitView app resources.

rules.name: libappindicator-sys
rules.evidence: Both exact published crates record identical .cargo_vcs_info git commit eafd1e3682a1247f595410266091e9684021cb6f; sys package path_in_vcs=sys inherits upstream repository root MIT/Apache texts preserved in libappindicator 0.9.0.

rules.name: rsqlite-vfs
rules.evidence: Published Cargo.toml.orig uses license.workspace=true. Exact published crate VCS commit 1bb309784f25c401ddf95131dcde4c4cdad7aee7 resolves in authoritative sqlite-wasm-rs upstream; MIT workspace license preserved.

rules.name: selectors
rules.evidence: Exact crate declares MPL-2.0, source files reference MPL 2.0, and no Incompatible With Secondary Licenses marker was found in archived Rust sources. No standalone license shipped in crate or root at its VCS commit. Preserve authoritative Mozilla MPL 2.0 text; GPLv3 secondary-license rules apply.

rules.name: winapi-i686-pc-windows-gnu
rules.evidence: Authoritative winapi-rs commit 796a8e6c2971dc2ff1bcff166e6671284f9b5b6b i686/Cargo.toml declares exact name/version 0.4.0 and MIT/Apache-2.0; both colocated license texts preserved. These Windows GNU import libraries are platform-specific.

rules.name: winapi-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu
rules.evidence: Authoritative winapi-rs commit 796a8e6c2971dc2ff1bcff166e6671284f9b5b6b x86_64/Cargo.toml declares exact name/version 0.4.0 and MIT/Apache-2.0; both colocated license texts preserved. These Windows GNU import libraries are platform-specific.

rules.name: brotli-decompressor
rules.evidence: Historical BSD-3-Clause/MIT metadata is not treated as a dual-license shortcut: crate LICENSE covers Dropbox BSD-3-Clause code, while src/context.rs explicitly carries Copyright 2013 Google Inc. and MIT terms. Retain BOTH BSD and complete original Brotli Authors MIT grant preserved by the related locked brotli package; select BSD-3-Clause AND MIT.

rules.name: @shikijs/langs
rules.evidence: Shiki v4.4.3 pnpm-lock.yaml pins tm-grammars 1.32.3. Retain that exact published collection's complete NOTICE with each original grammar copyright/grant, not only Shiki's wrapper MIT license. The local grammar NOTICE is byte-identical to the exact npm archive.

rules.name: @shikijs/themes
rules.evidence: Shiki v4.4.3 pnpm-lock.yaml pins tm-themes 1.12.3. Its original NOTICE preserves MIT copyright/grants for GitHub Light and Dark (Primer), Catppuccin Latte (Catppuccin), Solarized Light (VS Code) and the rest of the distributed collection. Local NOTICE bytes match the exact npm archive.

rules.name: @shikijs/engine-oniguruma
rules.evidence: The exact engine manifest pins vscode-oniguruma 1.7.0. Its inlined wasmBinary and Shiki's onig.wasm are byte-identical to release/onig.wasm in that integrity-verified npm artifact (SHA-256 fd885c2d12e5951e59d761ebd4a006e06254b1491fd6f530c92b69fb4d8d77d9). Preserve Microsoft MIT binding rights AND K.Kosako BSD-2-Clause Oniguruma 6.9.5_rev1 original notices.
